_comment: red-pill settings fragment for Claude Code. Merged (not overwritten) into settings.json by scripts/inject_settings.py. Grants the agent access to its transversal dirs OUTSIDE the workspace. NO defaultMode here on purpose: autonomous bypass is a per-launch CLI flag, never a shared-session default.
_comment_hooks: Stop hook = RAW CAPTURE LAYER for Claude Code, symmetric to the opencode scribe plugin. Deterministically queues each turn's prompt+response into memory_queue, so capture no longer depends on the agent invoking the handshake relay. UserPromptSubmit + Stop also mark the session liveness heartbeat (RFC-DESPERTAR-001 P4: empty .start/.end files under ${STATE_DIR}/sessions/live/, mtime = signal); StopFailure (API error, fires instead of Stop) and SessionEnd close the turn (.end) via redpill_turn_start.py. An Esc interrupt fires no hook (TTL SESSION_ACTIVE_MIN covers it). Scripts deployed to ~/.claude/hooks/ by inject_settings.py from seeds/settings/hooks/ (always named redpill_*.py: that prefix marks a hook block as red-pill's, so the injector replaces a changed block instead of duplicating it).
_comment_harness: Harness hook (redpill_harness.py) = IDENTITY INJECTION for Claude Code, symmetric to opencode's redpill-harness.js (RFC-HARNESS-001): SessionStart (startup/resume/clear/compact) injects the full identity via POST /hook/context on the backend socket; UserPromptSubmit injects the light block (clock + telemetry + coro); Stop/StopFailure ack the turn (/hook/ack). Output goes as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Its presence is what lets inject_anchor.py seed the `hook` variant of the handshake anchor for claude-code.
